docsAbstentionRebaseline.reason: The October source-declared documentation policy trades documentation coverage for evidence: documentation lookups now abstain unless docs are source-declared. After the 2026-10-27 full-index catch-up refresh, observed rates were minTaskHitRate 0.476, minFieldHitRate 0.7196, documentation intent 0.2455 (baselines were 0.525/0.734/0.543 under the pre-policy inferred-docs population). This is a real consumer-facing coverage reduction, accepted by the trust model (correct abstention over inferred URLs), not a measurement error. Thresholds are set just below observed values. Revisit if documentation extraction regains declared-source coverage.
